name: icims: standard /job path, query params dropped
spec_quote: Return `https://<host lowercased>/jobs/<digits><slug part>/job?in_iframe=1`, where the slug part is `/<slug>` when the path segment after the digits exists and is not exactly `job`, `login` or `candidate` (case-insensitive) — otherwise it is empty. Every query parameter of the input (mode=apply, mobile, …) and everything after the slug is dropped.

name: icims: http accepted, real slug kept
spec_quote: http and https inputs are both accepted. ... the slug part is `/<slug>` when the path segment after the digits exists and is not exactly `job`, `login` or `candidate` (case-insensitive)

name: icims: slug 'Login' is case-insensitively excluded, host lowercased
spec_quote: Return `https://<host lowercased>/jobs/<digits><slug part>/job?in_iframe=1`, where the slug part is ... not exactly `job`, `login` or `candidate` (case-insensitive) — otherwise it is empty.

name: icims: non-iCIMS host -> null
spec_quote: A link that is not an iCIMS posting (other host, no /jobs/<digits>) → null.

name: wd: og:title with empty content -> gone
spec_quote: True only when the HTML has a `<meta ... property="og:title" ...>` tag AND that tag has no non-empty `content="..."` attribute (missing or `content=""`).

name: wd: og:title without content attribute at all -> gone
spec_quote: True only when the HTML has a `<meta ... property="og:title" ...>` tag AND that tag has no non-empty `content="..."` attribute (missing or `content=""`).

name: wd: og:title with non-empty content -> not gone
spec_quote: A tag with a non-empty content → false. Attribute order inside the tag does not matter

name: wd: no og:title tag at all -> false even though a meta has empty content
spec_quote: No og:title tag at all → false.

name: clean: iCIMS junk params removed, ? dropped when nothing remains
spec_quote: On hosts ending in `.icims.com`, these query parameters are removed (name match case-insensitive): mode, in_iframe, mobile, ... Every other parameter is kept, byte for byte, in its order; when no parameter is left the `?` goes too.

name: clean: iCIMS keeps untracked params in original order
spec_quote: these query parameters are removed (name match case-insensitive): mode, in_iframe, mobile, needsRedirect, width, height, ... Every other parameter is kept, byte for byte, in its order

name: clean: non-iCIMS host keeps mode/width but drops tracking params
spec_quote: Tracking parameters (utm_*, source, src, ref, gh_src, …) are removed on every host. ... On hosts that are NOT *.icims.com, mode / width / height / mobile / in_iframe etc. are kept.

name: clean: non-http(s) input -> empty string
spec_quote: A non-http(s) input → "".

name: closed_on: label + 'on' + abbreviated month with period, past date
spec_quote: then an optional `:` or `：`, optional "on ", then a date in one of: `November 5, 2026` / `Nov 5, 2026` / `Nov. 5 2026` (month name, day, year; comma optional)

name: closed_on: first label parses to a future date -> null (later past date ignored)
spec_quote: Only the FIRST label+date that parses is used: if that date is before `today` return it as YYYY-MM-DD, otherwise null (a later past date does not count).

name: closed_on: label after a '|' separator, US m/d/y format
spec_quote: Labels (case-insensitive) at the start of a line (after a newline, or after a `|` separator, or at the very start): `Closed`, ... `11/05/2026` (US month/day/year)

name: closed_on: label not at line start (mid-sentence) -> null
spec_quote: Labels (case-insensitive) at the start of a line (after a newline, or after a `|` separator, or at the very start)

name: page_verdict: security phrase in title -> stop
spec_quote: "stop": the title matches a security check / CAPTCHA phrase (verify you are human, ... checking your browser, "just a moment...", ...)

name: page_verdict: redirect to a sign-in page -> login
spec_quote: "login": final_url looks like a sign-in page (a path segment login / signin / sign-in / sso / auth / oauth / oauth2 / saml, ...) while the original url did not.

name: page_verdict: http 404 -> closed

args.title: Acme Careers
args.text: The page could not be served.

spec_quote: 3. "closed": http is 404 or 410.

name: page_verdict: short page with closed notice -> closed (not unreadable)

args.title: Acme Careers
args.text: This job is no longer available.

spec_quote: 4. "closed": the head has a closed-posting notice (e.g. "no longer available", ...) AND (the text is shorter than 3000 characters OR fewer than 3 job words ...)

name: page_verdict: notice present but long text with many job words -> ok

text_repeat.chunk: This position is no longer available in the archive. Responsibilities, qualifications, requirements, skills and experience: you will own duties.

spec_quote: 4. "closed": the head has a closed-posting notice ... AND (the text is shorter than 3000 characters OR fewer than 3 job words ... occur in the first 20000 characters). ... 9. otherwise "ok"

name: page_verdict: very short page -> unreadable
spec_quote: 8. "unreadable": the text is shorter than 600 characters, or fewer than 2 job-word occurrences.

name: render_pick: picks unreadable with http ats_url, drops login-mention, orders by score
spec_quote: A line is picked when: status is "unreadable"; its job has an ats_url starting with "http"; that ats_url is not on linkedin.com, joinhandshake.com, jobright.ai, zapply.jobs or vansh.nyc; and its "why" does not mention "needs a login", "security check" or "captcha" (case-insensitive).

name: render_pick: blocked host, non-http ats_url, security/captcha why -> empty
spec_quote: its job has an ats_url starting with "http"; that ats_url is not on linkedin.com, joinhandshake.com, jobright.ai, zapply.jobs or vansh.nyc; and its "why" does not mention "needs a login", "security check" or "captcha" (case-insensitive).

name: render_pick: missing score counts as 0, ties by id ascending
spec_quote: Order: higher score first (missing score = 0), ties by id ascending.

name: render_pick: cap truncates the ordered list
spec_quote: Order: higher score first (missing score = 0), ties by id ascending. At most `cap` items; cap 0 or negative → none.

name: render_merge: missing v leaves x unchanged
spec_quote: Missing v → x unchanged.

name: render_merge: v ok, title falls back to x.title, loc from x
spec_quote: v.status "ok" → x with status "ok", text = v.text, title = v.title (or x.title, or ""), loc = x.loc (or ""), why "rendered in the job Chrome"

name: render_merge: v closed prefixes why
spec_quote: v.status "closed" → status "closed", why = "rendered: " + v.why; ... Other fields of x (id, key, level) are kept.

name: render_merge: other v status -> unreadable with both whys
spec_quote: any other v.status → status "unreadable", why = "rendered: " + v.why + " | " + x.why.
